scripts.bootstrap: npm run bootstrap:script && npm run bootstrap:git && npm run bootstrap:cleanup
scripts.bootstrap:cleanup: npm pkg delete scripts.bootstrap scripts.bootstrap:windows scripts.bootstrap:unix scripts.bootstrap:cleanup scripts.bootstrap:git scripts.bootstrap:script && git add . && git commit --amend -m"Bootstrap babylonjs-template"
scripts.bootstrap:git: git reset ad9ccb09 && git add . && git commit --amend -m"." && git checkout -b main && git branch -D bootstrap
scripts.bootstrap:script: node -e "process.platform === 'win32' ? require('child_process').execSync('npm run bootstrap:windows', {stdio: 'inherit'}) : require('child_process').execSync('npm run bootstrap:unix', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.bootstrap:unix: cp ./bootstrap.bat ./bootstrap.sh && chmod +x bootstrap.sh && ./bootstrap.sh && rm bootstrap.sh && rm bootstrap.bat
